institutions.name: The Acoustic Excise
institutions.mandate: Extract civic tithes by measuring the physical mass of condensed spoken pledges
institutions.decision_rule: If pledge weight exceeds registered tariff balance, impound speech-capsule until fee is cleared

institutions.name: Gantry Runners Syndicate

institutions.decision_rule: Route promises along shortest bridge path; dump heaviest insolvent vows into the abyss if unpaid for 30 cycles
institutions.visible_output: Chalkboard ledger boards mounted on canyon towers logging outstanding deliveries

institutions.name: The Silence Assembly
institutions.mandate: Adjudicate breached covenants and dissolve toxic public vows
institutions.decision_rule: Unanimous vote required to grind broken promise-capsules into civic mortar
institutions.visible_output: Dust plumes and white mortar applied to cliff reinforcement walls

premise: In a vertiginous canyon city, spoken vows take on literal physical mass. The state taxes speech by weight upon utterance, and couriers must physically haul defaulted promises between precariously perched households.
simulation_objective: Balance civic solvency, acoustic taxation rates, and physical bridge stability against public unrest and communication collapse.
economy_focus: Weight-based debt logistics and verbal trade contracts
exploration_focus: Vertical cliffside navigation, precarious suspension networks, and acoustic catacombs
conflict_tone: Bureaucratic tension, vertical peril, and socio-economic friction
visual_style: Chalk cliff faces crisscrossed by brass wires, pneumatic counterweights, leather harnesses, and glowing glass vow-jars

gameplay_loops.label: Excise Tariff Adjustment & Debt Impound Loop
gameplay_loops.summary: Assayers weigh incoming promise capsules against registered balances, impounding over-weight vows and raising transit costs when strain spikes, directly driving state_transit_cost and altering state_promise_backlog.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Impounded spoken capsules pile up, rapidly increasing Unsettled Promise Mass until couriers face total gridlock.

gameplay_loops.label: Gantry Rigging Strain Relief & Abyss Purge Loop
gameplay_loops.summary: Riggers monitor cable tension under heavy debt traffic, dumping abandoned vow canisters into the depths or conducting emergency repairs, directly modifying state_bridge_strain and state_promise_backlog.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Pulley cables are fraying under physical promise weight, risking a catastrophic bridge snap if cargo is not cut.

gameplay_loops.label: Silence Assembly Dissolution & Mortar Compounding Loop
gameplay_loops.summary: Scriveners and vow grinders adjudicate insolvent contracts, pulverizing broken covenants into civic mortar to reinforce cliff walls, relieving state_promise_backlog but depressing state_civic_trust.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Citizens refuse to vocalize new legal covenants as the grinding of private vows into masonry spreads fear of voice seizure.

player_entry_points: Arrive as an audit-deputy assigned to inspect the overtaxed balance beams at the Excise Weigh-Beam Registry.
Descend into the Gantry Runners Bivouac as an out-of-work courier seeking lucrative defaulted promise routes.
Infiltrate the Undercleft Whisperer Exchange to negotiate low-density contracts for disenfranchised cliff clans.
Report to The Silence Assembly Mortar Basin as an apprentice tasked with handling hazardous breached vow powder.
conflict_hooks: A massive multi-generation debt capsule has begun to crack open under sheer mass in the central registry, threatening to acoustically deafen nearby gantry lines.
The Acoustic Excise doubled transit surcharges overnight, prompting courier runners to threaten a total blockade of vow deliveries over the main gorge.
A black-market dialect developed in the Undercleft is completely evading acoustic weigh-scales, starving the civic wall mortar compounders of binding dust.

open_action_examples.action_name: Surreptitiously Siphon Weight from Impounded Capsule
open_action_examples.situation: Attempting to lighten a family debt capsule resting in the weigh registry while the assayer is distracted by cable maintenance alarms.
coordinator_checks: Is the broker within arm's reach of the weigh-beam without breaking line-of-sight concealment?
Does the broker possess an unsealed resonance siphon canister to hold the extracted acoustic mass?
Is the assayer actively engaged in checking transit logs rather than inspecting the balance pans?

open_action_examples.action_name: Emergency Rigging Cutoff on Overburdened Freight
open_action_examples.situation: Cutting loose an insolvent high-weight promise shipment hanging on a fraying central pulley line before structural collapse.
coordinator_checks: Does the overseer have physical access to the primary shear levers in the depot?
Is the cable tension currently exceeding rated mechanical fatigue thresholds?
Has the cable-rider been given mandatory audio whistle warning to release harness clips?

open_action_examples.action_name: Commingle Mortar Dust with Contraband Whisper Vow
open_action_examples.situation: Mixing crushed illegal unbonded debt syllables into civic wall plaster to hide breached covenants from the registry.
coordinator_checks: Does the grinder hold uncertified promise fragments inside the mortar basin?
Is the scrivener's wax seal currently unapplied to the batch manifest?
Will the resulting compound alter structural resonance without triggering conduit sentry alarms?

open_action_examples.action_name: Levy Arbitrary Resonance Surcharge on Smuggled Slur
open_action_examples.situation: Demanding immediate transfer of salvaged echo tokens as an ad-hoc tariff before permitting salvage ascent.
coordinator_checks: Is the bailiff armed with an active tuning fork in direct confrontation on the registry landing?
Does the dredger hold uninspected speech-capsules recovered from abyss net lines?
Does the bailiff hold legal authority over the specific conduit gate being traversed?

social_rules: No sworn vow may be whispered within earshot of an Excise balance beam without paying the ambient acoustic fee.
A promise-capsule dropped into the abyss cannot be redeemed or litigated once the third echo fades.
Grinding a covenant before the Silence Assembly delivers a final seal incurs immediate physical custody of the debtor's voice-token.
Rigging lines carry absolute right-of-way for overloaded debt runners over pedestrian cliff-dwellers.

visual_consistency_rules: Maintain strict 90-degree zenith top-down perspective with no 3/4 face or shoulder tilt.
Enforce single-pixel solid ink black perimeter outlines on all 64x64 sprites.
Ensure promise jars and ampoules have clear, bright teal (#76c0b3) core pixels for readability.

All fabrics must display visible chalk dusting, grease staining, or wax treatment texture.
